critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to ~1130 lines; still single-file. Recommend splitting into routers (auth, claimants, weeks, contacts, admin, reminders, reports) — not blocking but increasingly important.

forgot-password always returns 200 (correct - prevents enumeration). password_resets has no TTL index on `expires_at` field used as ISO string — works for queries but Mongo cannot auto-expire. Consider storing as BSON datetime + TTL index for housekeeping.
_send_user_reminder uses send_email return-bool to gate audit logging — good; audit only logs successful sends.
Admin role check uses Depends(require_admin); endpoints correctly excluded from non-admin (403 verified).
Edit-diff uses simple string compare with '→' arrow — works; covers all keys in model. Numbers/booleans like `certified` correctly stringified via fallback.
Claimant DELETE cascades benefit_weeks + contacts AND re-assigns active_claimant_id to remaining claimant or null — verified.
CSV export streams via StreamingResponse with proper Content-Disposition filename — correct.
Calendar page wired with Prev/Next month navigation (tested - works).
